verdict.rationale: Galileo has strong, repeated documentation and cookbooks for LangChain/LangGraph instrumentation (e.g., agent-langchain, multi-agent-langgraph, langgraph-otel-cookbook) plus generic OTel-based distributed tracing that could integrate with other SDKs. However, there is no direct evidence of a dedicated OpenAI SDK integration or any Vercel AI SDK integration—OpenAI usage appears only indirectly via LangChain agents. missing for 10: dedicated OpenAI SDK integration docs, Vercel AI SDK integration or cookbook, independent/hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs.
